notes.title: Update Information (210506)
notes.notes:
An update has been released.
--------------------------------

[i]Note: This only applies to Windows and Linux/Steam OS users[/i]

-Voice desync which occurred when switching languages is now fixed. Further desync when using rollback after switching languages is also fixed.
-There is a high possibility that your previous save files will cause the game to crash. In some cases, selecting 'Rollback' a few times may break out of the crash and allows you to re-save. For users that don't want to use the new update, the previous build can be accessed by right-clicking 'Fatal Twelve' in your Steam Library, selecting Properties, and under Betas, select 'old_build'.
-As always, users may need to delete the [i]persistent[/i] files in case achievements suddenly stop working.

[b]Additional Update:[/b]
There was an issue where suddenly certain background images were not appearing correctly. The issue has been fixed just now so please update your game in Steam if you haven't done so already.

notes.title: Build Updated with Language Toggle
notes.notes:
While this week marks the 2nd anniversary of the original release of Fatal Twelve, we have some more important news for everyone.

After some hiccups with the recent Simplified Chinese language update, we decided to hunker down and add in a feature to be able to toggle the language without having to go into the Steam Library and do so which required you to restart your game. The update should already be available but if you haven't received it yet then you may need to restart the Steam client for the update to start.

The language toggle can be accessed from within the Settings menu at any time.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28364974/b01175e42ea7cdf00351be521e759f466c543e69.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28364974/d08bfafda997a0c8127141accf2ed41e628f990c.jpg[/img][/url]

As always thank you to everyone, especially our Kickstarter backers for making this game a reality. And once more, Fatal Twelve is on sale this week, as well as the DLC, at a 50% discount so if you haven't already picked it up then don't let this opportunity pass you by!

notes.title: Fatal Twelve Now Available in Simplified Chinese!
notes.notes: Sorry for the delay on this but the Simplified Chinese version of Fatal Twelve is now available on Steam! If you were on the fence about picking up the game, it's 50% off this week to celebrate the 2nd anniversary of it's release so don't hesitate to pick it up today!

notes.title: Issues with English Build
notes.notes:
Some users reported that there were issues loading up the English build for Fatal Twelve. We've looked into it and the recent update pushed just a few minutes ago should fix the issue. There was a mix-up while uploading the Traditional Chinese language build that caused the other language builds to stop functioning properly due to a misplaced file.

We apologize for the inconvenience this may have caused.

notes.title: Fatal Twelve is now available in Chinese!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28364974/1e6801cb8311794c3e01975e42234ca29ad5638a.png[/img]
Thank you to everyone for your patience! As announced back during the Kickstarter campaign for Fatal Twelve, we're pleased to say that the Chinese translation of Fatal Twelve is now available for download!

If you already have the game installed, you can switch languages by right clicking on Fatal Twelve in your Library and selecting Properties. From there, click the Language tab and select Traditional Chinese from the dropdown. The update will begin downloading right away.

If you're on the fence about picking up Fatal Twelve, it's currently on sale right now during the Steam Winter Sale so don't miss out on this opportunity!

notes.title: Update on Chinese Language Localization
notes.notes:
Just a heads up for everyone but the Chinese language localization for Fatal Twelve is nearly finished. The majority of the text has been translated with only UI related text left to be translated. Once that's done, the scripts will be sent to the developer to integrate into the build. At that point a build will be sent to QA for some testing before we push the update to all users.

We appreciate everyone's patience regarding this update. Stay tuned for more information as we get it.

notes.title: Regarding the voice lag issue
notes.notes:
Some users are reporting an issue where the voices don't seem to match the corresponding line in the game. The developer is currently working on a permanent fix. In the meanwhile, they've offered up some temporary solutions to try.

1) When the issue occurs when using the mouse wheel to rollback through the game text, if you go back far enough through that character's lines, the issue is sometimes fixed. If it does get fixed, return to the point in the game where the issue first happened and after confirming that the issue is resolved, overwrite your save file.

2) Load save data at a point before the issue occurs.

3) Go back to the title screen and start a new game.

This issue will be resolved as quickly as possible. We apologize for trouble this may have caused.

notes.title: Fatal Twelve Site Open!
notes.notes:
Hey Folks!

We've got some more information for Fatal Twelve for your perusal. Aiueo Kompany has launched the official website for Fatal Twelve which gives an information packed look at the story and the characters in the game.

One of the highlights are voice samples from the main characters in Fatal Twelve. Unfortunately, recording wasn't done in time for the demo that was released last week but you can definitely get a feel for how Rinka and the crew sound like by checking out the official page.

For those of you curious, here's a listing of the voice cast of the main four girls:

Shishimai Rinka (CV: Matsui Eriko)
[i](Kamiya Nao in THE iDOLM@STER CINDERELLA GIRLS)[/i]
[i](Yonomori Benio in Engaged to the Unidentified)[/i]

Hitsuji Naomi (CV: Kakumoto Asuka)
[i](Shimabara Elena in THE IDOLM@STER MILLION LIVE)[/i]
[i](Serizawa Maiko in One Week Friends)[/i]

Mishima Miharu (CV: Komagata Yuri)
[i](Takayama Sayoko in THE IDOLM@STER MILLION LIVE)[/i]
[i](Torii Aki in Mangirl!)[/i]

Parca (CV: Nomura Kanako)
[i](Nikaido Chizuru in THE IDOLM@STER MILLION LIVE)[/i]
[i](Kobayashimaru Shouko in Bodacious Space Pirates)[/i]

As always, there's less than a week left for the Kickstarter campaign. If you're curious about the game, definitely give the demo a spin. And if cool goodies is also of interest then definitely stop over and check out the Kickstarter campaign!

For more information:

Fatal Twelve Offical Site (English):
http://fatal12.com/en.html

Fatal Twelve Kickstarter Campaign:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sekaiproject/fatal-twelve-a-thrilling-mystery-vn-with-full-voic/
